corrections.fix: Dalio correctly called the 1982 EM debt default but wrongly predicted a terrible debt crisis and depression; August 1982 (Dow 777) was the exact stock market bottom, so he lost money and learned humility about being wrong.

corrections.issue: Over-interpretation: Dalio does not say devaluation effects depend on whether inflation follows; he only notes that in 1973 the dollar devaluation came with inflation, the oil crisis and falling stocks.
